department: Department of Molecular and Cellular Biology

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm (US Eastern).

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including subject tests, are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that GRE scores are not accepted.

gre_general.value: Do not send GRE General scores; they are not accepted.

supervisor.value: You do three eight-week lab rotations in the first year, then choose a home lab.
supervisor.quote: G1 students carry out three different lab rotation projects during the first year with program faculty. | Following the three intense eight-week rotation periods, students will select a suitable home lab by the end of May of the spring term.

funding.value: All Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD students get guaranteed funding for the first five years.
funding.quote: Our financial aid program features guaranteed funding for the first five years to all PhD students

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree; for international applicants a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from a recognized institution is accepted.
entry_route.quote: welcomes applications for admission from individuals who have or will have by the time of matriculation a BA, BS, or equivalent undergraduate degree (for prospective international students, a three- or four-year undergraduate degree from an institution of recognized standing)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 5 on the new scale (100 for tests taken before January 21, 2026), with Speaking at least 4.5 (23 old scale); higher than the GSAS minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT minimum score: 5 (100 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026) | TOEFL iBT minimum Speaking score: 4.5 (23 for tests taken prior to January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 overall with Speaking at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS minimum score: 7 | IELTS minimum Speaking score: 6.5

notes: Part of Harvard Integrated Life Sciences. The statement of purpose must name three program faculty you would like to work with. Harvard also runs separate PhDs in Organismic and Evolutionary Biology and Human Evolutionary Biology.
